metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'Azure - Key Vault Access Policy or Network ACL Modified'

properties.displayName: Azure - Key Vault Access Policy or Network ACL Modified
properties.description:
Detects a write to a Key Vault's access policy, firewall rules, or top-level
vault configuration. This is the second half of the Key Vault attack path:
first weaken the vault's access controls — grant a policy that allows secrets
to be read, or open the firewall so the attacker's address is permitted — and
then harvest credentials. Pairs with the "Key Vault Secret Access Spike" rule,
which detects the harvesting step. Alerting on the control change catches the
intrusion before the secrets leave.
properties.query:
let sensitive_operations = dynamic([
  "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/WRITE",
  "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/ACCESSPOLICIES/WRITE",
  "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/FIREWALLRULES/WRITE",
  "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/PRIVATEENDPOINTCONNECTIONS/WRITE",
  "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/PRIVATEENDPOINTCONNECTIONS/APPROVEPRIVATEENDPOINTCONNECTION/ACTION"
]);
let excluded_callers = dynamic([]);
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OperationNameValue in (sensitive_operations)
| where ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where Caller !in (excluded_callers)
// The request body carries the new ACL/policy state. It is occasionally
// truncated on very large payloads, so the extracted values are triage aids —
// treat a null as "open the Azure Activity record", not as "no change".
| extend props = parse_json(tostring(Properties))
| extend reqBody = parse_json(tostring(props.requestbody))
| extend vaultProps = parse_json(tostring(reqBody.properties))
| extend DefaultNetworkAction = tostring(vaultProps.networkAcls.defaultAction)
| extend FirewallBypass = tostring(vaultProps.networkAcls.bypass)
| extend AccessPolicyCount = array_length(vaultProps.accessPolicies)
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceId, ResourceGroup,
          OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue,
          DefaultNetworkAction, FirewallBypass, AccessPolicyCount, props

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{Caller}} performed {{OperationNameValue}} on {{ResourceId}} from {{CallerIpAddress}}. Verify the new access policy or network ACL is an approved change before treating it as routine.
